The '''Serene Meadow''' was a meadow in the [[Alsakan Lowlands]], a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. It was home to a number of [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]], [[vorn tiger]]s, and [[iraida]]s,<ref name="TOR" /> and both [[Wardpost Duvaal]] and the [[House Teral (estate)|estate]] of [[House Teraan]] were located on the meadow.
